chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ishaq narrated that Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Salih al-Bukhari narrated that Yaqoob ibn Hamid ibn Kasib narrated that Sufyan ibn Ayyineh narrated from Abi Najih, from his father, from Rabi'ah al-Jarshi, that he mentioned Ali (peace be upon him) in the presence of Muawiyah, and Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas was with him.

So Sa'd said to him: 'You mention Ali. Indeed, he has four virtues; if I had even one of them, it would be more beloved to me than [so and so], mentioning the red camels (a measure of wealth). [These virtues are]: The Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) saying: 'I will give the standard tomorrow,' and his (peace be upon him and his family) saying: 'You are to me as Aaron was to Moses,' and his (peace be upon him and his family) saying: 'Whosever I am his Mawla, Ali is his Mawla.' And Sa'd forgot the fourth.
ai.seo_question: What are the four virtues of Imam Ali mentioned by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Khisal, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas acknowledges four unique virtues of Imam Ali (AS) that surpass even immense wealth, citing the Prophet's promise of the Khaybar flag, the 'Harun from Musa' analogy, and the Ghadir declaration. His forgetting of the fourth virtue underscores the incomparable and multifaceted nature of Ali's status in Shia tradition. This account highlights the early recognition of Ali's distinct spiritual and political authority by prominent companions.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-34 Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ishaq narrated that Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Salih al-Bokhari quoted Yaqoob ibn Hamid ibn Kasib, on the authority of Sufyan ibn Ayyineh, on the authority of Abi Najih, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Rabi’at al-Jarshi , “There was a mention of Ali (MGB) in the presence of Muawiyah when Sa’ed ibn Abi Vaqas was present.

Se’ed said, ‘You mentioned Ali’s name. Indeed Ali (MGB) had four characteristics. If I had even one of these qualities, it would be better than everything, even owning a flock of red-haired camels . Remember that the Prophet said the following in the Battle of Khaybar, ‘Tomorrow I shall hand the flag to the one (whom God and the Prophet love, and he loves God and the Prophet.) Also remember that the Prophet said to Ali (MGB), ‘Your position relative to me is the same as Aaron’s position relative to Moses.’ Sa’ed forgot the fourth.”
